text: get aim context should return (almost) all parent aims - path to root.
description: Return full root ancestry for orientation. Preserve the value-guided path_to_root for backward compatibility, and add paths_to_root containing every distinct root-first path through branching parents. Guard each branch against cycles, exclude cyclic dead ends from root paths, use explicit safety bounds with a truncation flag, and keep MCP and filesystem-backed agent-tools behavior aligned.

reflections.context: get_aim_context only returned immediate parents; aim wanted the full lineage to the root goal.
reflections.outcome: Added path_to_root: loads the graph once, reuses calculateAimValues' flowValues to pick the highest value-inflow parent at each branch, cycle-guarded, capped at 12, ordered root-first. Verified live on single-hop, multi-hop, and 4-parent-branch cases.
reflections.effectiveness: Reusing the existing value model gave principled branch selection for free and replaced N per-parent round-trips with one graph load.
reflections.lesson: When a tool needs graph-wide reasoning, load the whole aim list once and reuse calculateAimValues rather than fetching node-by-node.

reflections.context: Felix asked whether get_aim_context returns every ancestry path when parents branch; inspection confirmed it returned only one greedy highest-value path plus immediate parents.
reflections.outcome: Added paths_to_root and paths_to_root_truncated to both MCP and filesystem-backed agent-tools implementations. Paths are root-first, branch-local cycle safe, include shared ancestors on each legitimate route, and exclude branches that only close cycles. Preserved path_to_root as the backward-compatible value-guided path and updated the tool description and regression test.
reflections.effectiveness: The full MCP aim-tool test file passes using Node's direct tsx import (the package CLI is blocked only by sandbox IPC), MCP TypeScript compilation passes, agent-tools typecheck passes, and git diff --check passes. A live probe confirms the current long-running MCP process still has the old schema, so live acceptance waits for natural reconnect.
reflections.lesson: Immediate parents plus one preferred lineage are insufficient for aims serving multiple missions; orientation must expose every legitimate root path while separately retaining a preferred path for compact prioritization.
reflections.pattern: Represent exhaustive ancestry and preferred ancestry as separate fields; use per-branch cycle guards and disclose truncation rather than silently dropping alternate missions.

status.comment: Extended from one greedy highest-value path to all distinct root paths, preserving path_to_root compatibility. Focused/full MCP aim-tool test file and MCP/agent-tools TypeScript checks pass. Live MCP process still exposes the old schema until its next natural reconnect; awaiting live/user acceptance.
